title: Targeted Publication Revision Request
description: The decision payload for resolve_publication_approval() when decision=revision_requested. target_publication_sections empty/omitted means the whole package needs rework; a non-empty list identifies which sections the reviewer flagged. See docs/architecture/publication-package-pipeline.md#targeted-revision.

target_publication_sections.description: Empty/omitted = revise the whole package. Non-empty = the reviewer-identified sections needing rework.
